title: Lake gauge census: candidate selection and candidate-to-binding review rules (pre-registered)
registeredBefore: any census request was sent (none was sent under any earlier registration); no level value of any candidate has been read

purposes.BINDING: unprofiled directory lakes (not in Lake's reviewed set): find gauge-grade level series (DIRECT_LAKE_GAUGE or DIRECT_OPERATOR_POOL) for the next binding batch
purposes.INDEPENDENT_TRUTH: every lake with a binding (reviewed or candidate): list series that are NOT the lake's bound live/fallback/history series, with independence evidence, so the operator-truth validation v3 can freeze a truth list from metadata alone

scope.lakes: all 621 directory lakes (brains/moon/runtime/knowledge/lakes-directory.json, the projection of Sources/SectorEngine/Support/LakeDirectory.swift)
scope.reviewedSet: jobs/brain_platform/sector_brain_platform/publisher_live/customer_lake_level_eligible.json lakeIds (Lake's REVIEWED set: 5 pilots + accepted_batch.json + accepted_batch2.json)
scope.boundSeries: brains/lake/runtime/LakeBrain/LakeSourceBindingsGenerated.swift (all rows, reviewed and candidate) plus the 5 hand-written pilots in LakeSourceBindings.swift
scope.readOnlyInputs: the census reads these files and never writes them; it records their sha256 in its output

notBeforeReason: the operator-truth validation (PR #243) runs 2026-11-24..30 on the Mac mini; 12 h margin after its window. Every networked path refuses before this instant (the guard is in the fetcher, so controls, geometry and census are all covered). The Mini request adds a second gate: only after #243 has posted its result on #51

excludedSources.SWOT: not gauge grade for sourceAuthority; SWOT-only lakes dilute the quality shares until decision R10
excludedSources.TVA host: www.tva.com is never queried (robots); USGS gauges at TVA reservoirs are the alternative
excludedSources.NWS NWPS / IEM HADS: redistributions of another agency's DCP; not queried, and never counted as independent truth
excludedSources.USGS 00065 gage height: a local-datum stage, not an elevation; out of scope for this census

cwms-data.usace.army.mil.terms: US Government public data, no key (https://cwms-data.usace.army.mil/cwms-data/)

storage.googleapis.com.terms: Sector's own public Lake Registry bucket (sector-lake-registry), USGS NHD derived

fetch.robots: robots.txt is read once per host (RFC 9309, conservative): 2xx parsed; 401, 403 and 429 disallow all; other 4xx allow all; 5xx, a redirect or no answer disallow all. A disallowed path is never requested and is recorded ROBOTS_DISALLOWED per host and path
fetch.values: metadata only. The one data call (USGS instantaneous values, last 12 h) is made only for USGS POOL candidates of BINDING lakes that pass S1-S3 and S6 (the pre-shortlist); it keeps time stamps and drops every value at parse time. Liveness of every other row comes from catalog extents
fetch.redirects: never followed; a 3xx answer is recorded and treated as a failed request
fetch.retries: at most 2 retries (429, 5xx, network error); every attempt counts against maxRequests and is logged
fetch.partialOutput: a failed request, chunk or lake is recorded under errors (by stage) and the run continues; when the budget is exhausted the run stops discovery, finalizes what it has and sets summary.budgetExhausted; lakes not discovered are counted as notDiscovered, never as noCandidate
fetch.neverHostsNote: refused by the fetcher whatever the hosts table says (TVA's robots.txt is Disallow: / for all agents; NWPS/HADS are redistributions). The census never relies on tva.com: TVA reservoirs are reached only through USGS gauges
fetch.cwmsOfficeFailures: a failed CWMS office location catalog is never cached as empty: it is retried for the next lake, up to 3 failures per office per run; every lake discovered while an office was unavailable is marked CWMS_OFFICE_UNAVAILABLE (discovery incomplete) and is not counted as 'no candidate'
fetch.discoveryCompleteness:
every discovery failure marks the lake incomplete (summary.binding.incomplete), never noCandidate: PROVIDER_FAILED:

, PROVIDER_DISABLED:

(a failed positive control), USGS_BOX_TOO_LARGE, USGS_TSMETA_UNAVAILABLE, CWMS_OFFICE_UNAVAILABLE:, CWMS_LOCATIONS_TRUNCATED:, CWMS_TS_UNAVAILABLE:, CWMS_TS_TRUNCATED:, RISE_CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE, RISE_CATALOG_PARTIAL, RISE_CATALOG_TRUNCATED, RISE_DETAIL_UNAVAILABLE:, RISE_ITEM_UNAVAILABLE:, GEOMETRY_UNAVAILABLE (the Lake Registry index or the lake's outline could not be read; a lake whose registry entry has no geometry is POINT_ONLY by design, not incomplete), USGS_OGC_TRUNCATED (OGC API next links followed up to the page cap), USGS_SITE_ERROR (WaterServices answered anything but 200 or a well-formed empty result and the OGC fallback failed), USGS_SITE_NO_COORDINATES (a site row in the lake's box without coordinates), CWMS_LOCATION_NO_COORDINATES: and RISE_LOCATION_NO_COORDINATES (a location without coordinates whose state is the lake's state; one without a state is counted in the summary only). A failed or partial catalog (CWMS office locations, RISE locations) is never cached: it is retried for the next lake, at most 3 failures per catalog per run. A pagination cap that is reached marks the listing truncated, never complete
fetch.usgsEmpty: WaterServices answers 404 for an empty search; a 404 counts as an empty result only when its body says 'No sites found matching all criteria'; any other non-200 answer is a provider error (the OGC fallback is tried in auto mode)
fetch.ogcPagination: OGC API responses are followed through their rel=next links up to the page cap; reaching the cap with a next link left marks USGS_OGC_TRUNCATED

parameters.00062: reservoir surface elevation above a datum

cwms.parameter: Elev (base parameter); sub-parameters Pool / Forebay / Headwater count as pool, Tailwater never

classes.POOL: a pool/lake series inside the outline (or within R1) with no tailwater or river cue
classes.TAILWATER: a tailwater/outflow series, or a dam-cue station outside the outline
classes.RIVER: a river/creek station outside the outline with no pool cue
classes.RULE_CURVE: a guide/rule/plan/forecast series (the 2026-11-21 trap), any series whose latest time is in the future; never a level source
classes.UNKNOWN: cues conflict or are absent (including a CWMS sub-location Upper/Lower); hand review

classification.ruleCurveApplies: to a CWMS version and sub-parameter and to a RISE item title, never to a station or lake name
classification.futureLatest: a latest time after the census time plus the tolerance is a rule/plan series: class RULE_CURVE, never live. Tolerance: futureLatestToleranceHours for timestamped sources (CWMS extents, RISE end dates, USGS IV); futureLatestToleranceHoursDateGranular for date-granular sources (the USGS catalog end date, which is a day)
classification.derivedVersion: a CWMS version whose lower-cased text contains any of derivedVersionWords as a substring (so Rev2, Revised, Computed, Calc1, Best-NWO all match) is a derivation of another series; conservative: a false match only makes a row UNCERTAIN

selection.note: Stage A, metadata only. Decides which candidates go to the stage B binding review. Applies to purpose BINDING.
selection.S1_provider: provider has an Engine adapter: usgs (62614/62615/00062), cwms, rise
selection.S2_class: classification POOL; UNKNOWN goes to HAND_REVIEW; TAILWATER, RIVER, RULE_CURVE are rejected

S3_position.pointOnlyVerdict: HAND_REVIEW (no outline: R1 cannot be evaluated)

selection.S5_datum: a vertical datum is named by the parameter, the site or the location; missing datum -> HAND_REVIEW
selection.S6_host: robots allows the path and the host terms are listed in hosts
selection.S7_unique: the station is not bound by another REVIEWED lake, and no other directory lake has the station inside or nearer its outline
selection.S9_order: per lake: DIRECT_OPERATOR_POOL before DIRECT_LAKE_GAUGE, then inside before outside, then nearer, then longer record (begin date)

independence.note: Applies to purpose INDEPENDENT_TRUTH. Evidence from metadata only; each candidate is compared with every bound live, fallback and history series of the same lake.
independence.boundSeriesExcluded: a candidate equal to a bound series (same provider family and series; Access2Water and CWMS are one family when the time-series id matches) is not listed as a candidate
independence.originAgency: usgs -> USGS; rise -> USBR only when the RISE item's own metadata names the Bureau of Reclamation (USBR / Reclamation) as collector, source or agency, otherwise RISE_UNCONFIRMED (RISE republishes other agencies' data, including USGS); cwms/a2w -> by the version label: USGS -> USGS_COPY, USBR/BOR/Reclamation -> USBR_COPY, CDEC/DWR -> CDEC_COPY, NWS/NWPS/HADS -> NWS_REDISTRIBUTION, none -> USACE_UNLABELLED (origin unknown; SHEF is a transfer format, not an origin); tva -> TVA; nwps/hads -> NWS_REDISTRIBUTION. A labelled copy belongs to the labelled agency's family. Bound RISE items are RISE_UNCONFIRMED unless the census read their metadata and it names USBR

tiers.NOT_INDEPENDENT: same USGS site id as a bound series; or same CWMS base location as a bound cwms/a2w series (any sub-location, version or interval); or a labelled copy of an agency the lake already has a bound series from; or an NWS redistribution; or an overlapping or unknown origin within sameGaugeDistanceM of a bound gauge
tiers.INDEPENDENT_AGENCY: neither side is USACE_UNLABELLED or RISE_UNCONFIRMED (unless registered origin evidence resolves it), no derived version; origin agency families differ from every bound series', the site id differs, and every bound gauge has known coordinates at least sameGaugeDistanceM away
tiers.INDEPENDENT_SITE: same known origin agency family as a bound series (USACE_UNLABELLED and RISE_UNCONFIRMED never count as known), no derived version, a different site id and base location, at least otherSiteMinDistanceM from every bound gauge with known coordinates
tiers.UNCERTAIN: anything else, including any pair with USACE_UNLABELLED or RISE_UNCONFIRMED on either side, a derived CWMS version, a labelled copy of an agency the lake has no bound series from, and a bound gauge whose location is unknown (TVA, NWS)

independence.eligibleForV3: INDEPENDENT_AGENCY or INDEPENDENT_SITE, classification POOL, position inside or within S3, live by S4 from catalog extents; v3 freezes its own list from these rows under its own pre-registration
independence.boundCoordinates: USGS sites from the site service; CWMS/Access2Water from the office location catalog; RISE items from the fetched RISE locations (item -> location); TVA and NWS stay unknown
independence.structuralCap: a bound lake whose binding includes a gauge with unknown coordinates (TVA, NWPS, HADS) can never get an INDEPENDENT_* row; computed from the committed bindings at registration: 130 of 298 bound lakes (129 of 294 reviewed) can; the USGS/USACE border rule lowers the reachable number further for lakes bound to unlabelled CWMS series. The census reports the live figure
independence.unlabelledBorder: USACE_UNLABELLED is origin-unknown against every agency, including another USACE_UNLABELLED series (two unlabelled series can derive from one upstream sensor, and CWMS location coordinates are not sensor coordinates): any pair with USACE_UNLABELLED on either side is UNCERTAIN, never INDEPENDENT_*, unless an origin-evidence entry resolves it. An unlabelled series within sameGaugeDistanceM of any bound gauge is NOT_INDEPENDENT
independence.labelledCopy: a labelled copy (USGS_COPY, USBR_COPY, CDEC_COPY) is NOT_INDEPENDENT when the lake has a bound series of the same agency (it may copy that very gauge), and UNCERTAIN otherwise (the copied gauge is not identified)
independence.riseBorder: RISE_UNCONFIRMED is origin-unknown against every family, like USACE_UNLABELLED: any pair with RISE_UNCONFIRMED on either side (against USGS, USBR, USACE including evidence-USACE, CDEC_COPY, TVA, another RISE_UNCONFIRMED or any other origin) is UNCERTAIN, never INDEPENDENT_*; within sameGaugeDistanceM of a bound gauge it is NOT_INDEPENDENT
independence.sameBaseLocation: two CWMS/Access2Water series whose base location (the location id before the first '-', compared case-insensitively) is the same are NOT_INDEPENDENT (sub-locations such as Kinzua-Lake and Kinzua-Tailwater share one project)
independence.derivations: a CWMS series with a derived version (classification.derivedVersionWords) is NOT_INDEPENDENT against a bound series at the same base location and UNCERTAIN otherwise; the same holds in the other direction for a candidate against a bound derived series
independence.originEvidence: --origin-evidence: a reviewed JSON list of {provider, series, origin, evidence}; origin USACE for a cwms series, USBR for a rise item; written by the v3 pre-registration or the owner. None exists at registration

bindingReview.note: Stage B, run only after the census and after PR #243 has run. Uses level values. Same rules as batches 1-2 (binding-review-v1 R1-R9, the 2026-11-21 dry-run checks (b)-(d), the runner's 15 ft history/live rule). Not changeable after the census output exists.
bindingReview.R1_position: gauge <= 1.5 km of the outline (point-only lakes: hand review)
bindingReview.R2_identity: name similarity >= 0.5, or the gauge is inside the outline
bindingReview.R3_notTrap: no tailwater, river or well gauge; no guide/rule curve series
bindingReview.R4_state: the gauge's state is one of the lake's states
bindingReview.R5_unique: no better-matching lake claims the gauge; not bound by another reviewed lake
bindingReview.R6_live: last reading < 72 h old (daily feeds < 192 h)
bindingReview.R7_level: 30-day median within -25..+8 ft of the directory full pool; a lake with no full pool: n-a, then check (d) n-a and hand review
bindingReview.R8_datum: the vertical datum is identified and the same for live, fallback and history (or a recorded offset)
bindingReview.R9_second: an independent second origin agrees within 2 ft; n-a when none exists. The same gauge through another endpoint never counts (batch 2 rule)
bindingReview.check_b: primary vs fallback within 0.5 ft; any FAIL is held
bindingReview.check_c: live within 5 ft of the 7-day median
bindingReview.check_d: guide curve / operating zone / full pool within 25 ft of live
bindingReview.historyLive: seeded history 365-day median within 15 ft of live (historyLiveMismatch)
bindingReview.adapter: the provider has an Engine adapter; otherwise the lake moves to new-provider work, not to the batch
bindingReview.decision: every rule PASS or n-a and every check PASS -> proposed for the batch; any FAIL -> held with its reason; a FLAG -> hand review by the owner
bindingReview.noRelaxation: the target (>= 311 reviewed lakes, 50%) is never a reason to change a rule, threshold or classification after values are seen; report the count that passes

coverageArithmetic.ceilingBasis: the reviewed count read from customer_lake_level_eligible.json at run time (not this constant) plus the BINDING lakes with a SHORTLIST row

publication.output: local files in --out only (census.json, census.summary.json, robots.json, request log); registered in the Lake research folder's manifest on the Mac mini

supersedes.why: round-4 review of PR #247 (2026-11-23) before any request was sent: run binding (one ledger, only run #1 counts, fixed arguments), registered origin evidence, RISE_UNCONFIRMED origin-unknown against every family, geometry failures, OGC pagination, WaterServices 404, derived-version matching

controls.lakes: Allegheny Reservoir|PA (USGS 03012520 62615; CWMS Kinzua-Lake.Elev.Inst.1Hour.0.RESOPS), Bluestone Lake|WV (USGS 03179800 62614; CWMS Bluestone-Lake.Elev.Inst.15Minutes.0.OBS), Alcova Reservoir|WY (RISE 114)
controls.pass: every control series of the provider is rediscovered with class POOL; otherwise the provider is disabled for the run

summaryCounts: BINDING lakes split into withShortlist, handReviewOnly, noCandidate (discovery complete, nothing found), incomplete (discovery ran but a CWMS office or provider failed, nothing shortlisted) and notDiscovered (budget exhausted before the lake)

runBinding.folder: <research folder>/gauge-census/binding/LGC-2026-11-23.5/ : one global binding per rules id, inside the Lake research folder that Cortex research-path returns, never inside a run's output folder
runBinding.ledger: ledger.jsonl in the binding folder: append-only, hash-chained (each line carries the sha256 of the previous line; the first chains to sha256('genesis:<rulesId>:<rulesSha256>')), exclusive lock, fsync; the same shape as the Wind run ledger (tools/research/protocol_run_ledger.py, not yet on main); a broken chain or a clock earlier than the newest line refuses every later call

steps.controls: one-shot preflight (window 'all'); may run before the census
steps.census: one-shot (window 'all'): only run #1 counts. A run that ends before writing any output is ABORTED_NO_RESULT and does not block a retry; a run that started writing and failed is FAILED and blocks every later run; a COMPLETED run (including a budget-exhausted one) blocks every later run

runBinding.outputs: run #N writes to <binding folder>/run-<N>/ only, with create-exclusive writes (write-once); the tool chooses the folder, there is no --out for controls or census
runBinding.fixedArgumentsRule: the census refuses --lakes, any --registry other than the fixed value, and any --usgs-api other than 'auto'
runBinding.recorded: the START line records every argument, the tool and rules sha256, the input file hashes, the registry source, and the cache tree hash; the END line records the output hashes, the registry index sha256, the sha256 of every outline read, the cache tree hash after the run and the request, retry and cache-hit counts; every cache hit is a line in requests.jsonl (cacheHit true, with the cached file's sha256)
runBinding.cache: <binding folder>/cache/ (metadata responses only; USGS IV is never cached); shared by the attempts of one rules id
runBinding.skipControls: --skip-controls is accepted only when the ledger shows an earlier census attempt of this rules id that ended ABORTED_NO_RESULT and a controls record with no disabled provider (a COMPLETED controls step, or the PASS line logged by that aborted attempt)

originEvidenceRegistration.rule: an origin-evidence file is accepted only when its sha256 is listed in registeredFiles above or in a register-evidence LOG line of the run ledger written before census run #1 started; the census output records each file's sha256 and full text
originEvidenceRegistration.refuse: an entry for a CWMS series whose version already names an agency (USGS, USBR, CDEC, NWS copies stay copies) is refused; an entry must name provider, series, origin (USACE for cwms/a2w, USBR for rise) and an evidence text
